# nautobot_tenant_group (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a specific tenant group in Nautobot by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nautobot_tenant_group" "example" {
  name = "My Tenant Group Name"
}

output "data_tenant_group" {
  value = data.nautobot_tenant_group.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Tenant group's UUID.
- `name` (String) Tenant group's name.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Tenant group's creation date (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Tenant group's description.
- `display` (String) Human friendly display value for the tenant group.
- `last_updated` (String) Tenant group's last update date (RFC3339).
- `natural_slug` (String) Natural slug for the tenant group.
- `notes_url` (String) Notes URL for the tenant group.
- `parent_id` (String) UUID of the parent tenant group.
- `url` (String) URL of the tenant group.
